title: Constrained Command-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning with Bandit Strategy Selection in Real-Time Strategy Games
abstract: arXiv:2610.11663v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Deep reinforcement learning agents reach strong performance in real-time strategy games but can be brittle against opponents outside their training distribution. Separating strategic command selection from learned unit control allows different strategies to be selected for different opponents while reusing the same execution policy. This requires an executor that can follow different commands and measurable criteria for assessing whether it does so. We introduce a constrained command-conditioned Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) policy, the executor, for MicroRTS, a real-time strategy environment. Discrete commands specify strategic objectives and behavioral requirements for economy, army composition, military posture, and worker policy over multiple environment steps; the executor determines the unit-level actions used to fulfill them. translated_title: 实时战略游戏中结合赌博机策略选择的约束命令条件强化学习
translated_abstract: 深度强化学习智能体在实时战略游戏中能够达到很高的性能水平，但在面对训练分布之外的对手时可能表现脆弱。将战略命令选择与学习到的单位控制相分离，可以在复用同一执行策略的同时，针对不同对手选择不同的策略。这需要一个能够遵循不同命令的执行器，以及评估其是否做到这一点的可衡量标准。我们为实时战略环境MicroRTS引入了一种约束命令条件的近端策略优化（PPO）策略，即执行器。离散命令在多个环境步骤上规定了经济、军队构成、军事态势和工人策略等方面的战略目标与行为要求；执行器则决定用于实现这些目标的单位级动作。一个基于汤普森采样的赌博机充当战略家，基于对……的估计从……中选择命令元组（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文为MicroRTS提出了一种由汤普森采样赌博机作为战略家的约束命令条件PPO执行器框架，将战略命令选择与单位级控制分离，使智能体能在复用同一执行策略的同时针对不同对手切换策略，从而提升对训练分布之外对手的鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a constrained command-conditioned PPO executor paired with a Thompson-sampling bandit strategist for MicroRTS, separating strategic command selection from unit-level control so that different strategies can be selected for different opponents while reusing the same execution policy, improving robustness against out-of-distribution opponents.
